ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var body = java.getElements('@css:body').get(0);
var rows = body.select('ul.chapter li:has(a[href])');
if (body.select('.page a.next[href]').isEmpty()) {
    var detailHtml = java.ajax(String(book.bookUrl));
    if (detailHtml) {
        var preview = body.clone().empty().html(String(detailHtml)).select('ul.chapter li:has(a[href])');
        var seen = {};
        function chapterId(row) {
            return String(row.select('a[href]').first().attr('href')).split(/[?#]/)[0].split('/').pop();
        }
        for (var i = 0; i < rows.size(); i++) {
            seen[chapterId(rows.get(i))] = true;
        }
        for (var j = preview.size() - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
            var row = preview.get(j);
            var id = chapterId(row);
            if (!seen[id]) {
                rows.add(row);
                seen[id] = true;
            }
        }
    }
}
rows;
</js>
